question:
The following pie charts show the number of start-ups started in various sectors since 2016 and the number of successful start-ups in those sectors respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5391c91eafca9173d5276383629c4cb6e55995fdd55bb8ac897a8fd898b55ed0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c878c703455571b8a0dd9952063f72903d2b530d199a93f81f6e2b0c87c48d14.png] 

What is the ratio of the number of successful start-ups to that of the number of unsuccessful start-ups in the Fin-tech sector?
solution:
**Solution:**

From the pie chart 

Successful startups of the Fintech sector = 104

Total startups of fintech = 256

Unsuccessful startups = 256 - 104 = 152

The ratio of the number of successful start-ups to that of the number of unsuccessful start-ups in the Fin-tech sector = 104 :152 = 13 : 19

**Hence, the correct option is 4.**
